title: "Database directory already exists" and "Bag directory already exists" in rosbag2_py: new bag paths, close(), missing metadata.yaml, reindex and TopicMetadata id, measured
excerpt: Why SequentialWriter.open() refuses an existing folder, when metadata.yaml is written (close, del, exit, SIGKILL), what ros2 bag reindex recovers from killed sqlite3 and MCAP bags, and the TopicMetadata and write() TypeErrors. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
